## Why This Is Asked
Tests basic serverless API design, tenant isolation, and resilience in Azure.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Functions HTTP triggers
- Cosmos DB partitioning and upsert
- Idempotency with Idempotency-Key header
- Retry/backoff strategies and testability

## Code Example
```javascript
// Node.js example for upsert using Cosmos DB SDK
const { CosmosClient } = require("@azure/cosmos");

async function upsertItem(client, tenantId, item) {
  const id = `${tenantId}-${item.itemId}`;
  const { resource } = await client
    .database("InventoryDB")
    .container("Items")
    .item(id, tenantId)
    .replace({ id, tenantId, ...item });
  return resource;
}
```
